description: Genuine ZIP using BZIP2 compression (method 12), unsupported by the browser reader.
expected_messages: Advisory: ZIP compression: not supported — Re-export your project using standard ZIP compression (Deflate).
notes: Tiny archive-container fixture, not a complete coursework project; does not test compilation. ZIP method 12 (BZIP2). Independently readable with Python zipfile; unsupported by the browser reader. This does not establish corruption.

description: Genuine ZIP using LZMA compression (method 14), unsupported by the browser reader.
expected_messages: Advisory: ZIP compression: not supported — Re-export your project using standard ZIP compression (Deflate).
notes: Tiny archive-container fixture, not a complete coursework project; does not test compilation. ZIP method 14 (LZMA). Independently readable with Python zipfile; unsupported by the browser reader. This does not establish corruption.

description: Two different entries use exactly the same path, src/Main.java.
expected_messages: Critical: ZIP filenames: duplicate entries — The same file path appears more than once. Export a fresh ZIP with one copy of each file.
notes: Tiny archive-container fixture, not a complete coursework project; does not test compilation. Two entries named src/Main.java contain different classes (Main and Other). Extraction may overwrite one; a compilation failure is not guaranteed.

description: Two filenames differ only by case and conflict on typical Windows systems.
expected_messages: Critical: Archive check could not be completed — This ZIP contains duplicate paths or filenames that differ only in case or slash style. Check the listed files and export one unambiguous project.
notes: Tiny archive-container fixture, not a complete coursework project; does not test compilation. src/Main.java and src/main.java collide on typical Windows filesystems. They contain different class names; this tests extraction ambiguity, not a guaranteed compilation failure.

description: The same path is used as a file and as the parent folder of another file.
expected_messages: Critical: Archive check could not be completed — A file and a directory share the same path. Export a fresh ZIP of the project.
notes: Tiny archive-container fixture, not a complete coursework project; does not test compilation. The entry src is a file, but src/Main.java requires src to be a folder. Both cannot be extracted to those paths normally.

description: Entry uses a parent-directory path; the checker reports an unsafe path.
expected_messages: Critical: Archive check could not be completed — This ZIP contains a path that cannot be interpreted safely. Export a fresh ZIP of the project.
